issue_context.title: Window function LEAD and LAG's default value can not adapt to field type automatically
comments:
Confirming that this can be reproduced in master:
```sql
drop table if exists lt;
create table lt (d decimal(10, 4));
insert into lt values(0.2),(0.2);
select LEAD(d,1,1) OVER(), LAG(d,1,1) OVER() from lt;

..

mysql> select LEAD(d,1,1) OVER(), LAG(d,1,1) OVER() from lt;
+--------------------+-------------------+
| LEAD(d,1,1) OVER() | LAG(d,1,1) OVER() |
+--------------------+-------------------+
|             0.2000 |                 1 |
|                  1 |            0.2000 |
+--------------------+-------------------+
```
